name: Home Service Customer Retention & Reactivation Engine

parameters.content:
### SECTION 1: Load Customer Data
Read sheet → validate email → dedupe → calculate days since last service → categorize.

### SECTION 2: Customer Segmentation
8 parallel branches split the dataset into every customer segment.

### SECTION 3: Reactivation Campaigns
Email → wait 5d → check response → reactivated, or follow-up → wait 7d → final reminder.

### SECTION 8: Office Notifications
When a customer responds: alert Discord → log Notion → update the sheet.

### SECTION 4: Seasonal Maintenance
Determine season → reminder email → update Sheet/Calendar/Notion.

### SECTION 5: Membership Renewal
Reminder 1 → wait 7d → reminder 2 → update status.

### SECTION 6: Warranty Reminder
Inspection reminder → update CRM fields.

### SECTION 7: VIP Customer Care
Appreciation email + priority booking + loyalty discount → update status.

### SECTION 2b: Repeat Customers
Ask happy repeat customers for referrals.

### SECTION 2c: New Customers
Welcome sequence with care tips for brand-new customers.

### SECTION 9: Monthly Reporting
On the 1st: pull metrics → compile → email report → Discord summary → Notion dashboard.

## Home Service Customer Retention & Reactivation Engine
Runs daily at 09:00. Loads the Customer Database, segments customers, runs reactivation + renewal + reminder campaigns via Gmail, logs to Sheets/Notion, alerts the office on Discord, and emails a monthly report.

**Setup:** connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar & Notion credentials, select the Customer Database sheet + Notion database, and paste your Discord Webhook URL into the two Discord HTTP Request nodes.
